description: This is a test module for a FastAPI application. It defines test functions that utilize pytest fixtures and parameterization to test API endpoints, including request headers and schema correctness. It also imports the application module dynamically based on test parameters.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically loads a FastAPI app module based on test parameters and returns a TestClient instance for testing.

methods.name: test(path, headers, expected_status, expected_response, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that verifies the API's response for various headers and paths, checking status codes and JSON responses.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that retrieves and validates the OpenAPI schema JSON to ensure the API documentation is correct.

ctags.name: test
ctags.pattern: /^def test(path, headers, expected_status, expected_response, client: TestClient):$/
